_comment: The single burden lever, replacing the old per-item hand-tuned debuff list. An equipped item is a small component that is never merged into the host; the only thing carrying costs is its MASS, which is derived from the item's own composition (not stored or hand-tuned here). While equipped, the item's mass joins the carrier's total carried mass, which reduces the carrier's effective move and fine_controls. Equipping is gated on the host being able to bear the item's mass (a strength x mass check) — all-or-nothing, checked once at equip, never as a continuous debuff.

equipGate.description: The host's strength must be at least requiredStrengthPerUnitMass x the item's mass, or equip is denied — a component cannot bear part of a burden it cannot bear at all.
